Profile: Trippy

Hey, I'm Trippy — a video editor who works across different genres. From deep-dive analysis to quick reaction shorts, I bring stories to life through editing. Obsessed with pacing, color, and making every frame count.

What started as experimenting with different styles turned into a full-blown passion. Over 1M+ impressions later, I'm still the guy who stays up until 3AM fine-tuning transitions and hunting for the perfect clip.

Whether you're here for the long-form breakdowns or the quick shorts — welcome. Let's make something worth watching.
